3. The facts relevant for the purpose of this application are that the petitioner bank filed Money Suit No.8 of 1984 in the 3rd Court of Munsif, Comilla, against borrower, Sirajul Haque-the predecessor of these writ petitioners and others, for realisation of outstanding loan money and the said suit was renumbered as Artha Rin Suit No.295 of 1990 on transfer to the Artha Rin Adalat, Comilla, after promulgation of Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 1990 and the suit was decreed exparte for Tk.40,871.56/- by the judgment and decree dated 23.04.1.991 and for satisfaction of the said decree the petitioner bank filed Execution Case No.37 of 1993 in the year 1993 and there-after filed two other Execution cases, third one being Execution Case No.73 of 2000 which was dismissed for default on 06.08.2002 and thereafter the 4th Execution Case was filed being Execution Case No.220 of 2003 on 25.08.2003, which has been renumbered as Execution Case No.58 of 2004. The last Execution Case was filed after promulgation of the Artha. Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 and thereby the last Execution Case is to be proceeded with under the Provisions of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain 2003 in view of Section 60(3) of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain , 2003. As per Section 28 of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 an Execution Case is required to be filed within one year from the date of disposal of the earlier Execution Case but within 6 years from the date of the decree. The judgment debtor filed an application challenging the initiation and continuation of the proceeding of the Execution Case No.58 of 2004 on the ground that the Execution Case has been filed after the period of limitation as provided under Provision of Section 28(3) and (4) of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 inasmuch as the Execution Case was filed in the year 1993 and thereby the 6 years allowed under Section 28(4) of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 has expired. The petitioner bank resisted the application submitting that the suit was decreed in the year 1991 and at the relevant time, under .Section 48 of the Code of Civil Procedure an Execution Case can be filed within 12 years and that the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 having been promulgated long after 6 years from the date of judgment and decree passed in the suit in the year 1991 the provision of limitation provided in Section-28 of the Ain, 2003 can not be applied in the instant case and that the provisions of Section 48 of the Code of Civil Procedure is applicable in the instant case. The Executing Court accordingly admitted the Execution Case and being aggrieved there-against the judgment-debtor-respondent filed the writ petition challenging the issue of limitation and the High Court Division accepted the case of the judgment-debtor and made the Rule absolute. declaring the impugned order without lawful authority and of no legal effect observing that:- 

 "The learned Advocate for respondent-bank has argued that after coming of Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 into operation the execution cases filed earlier did not require to be taken into consideration at all the limitation for filing of the present execution case started running afresh from the date of promulgation of this new Ain of 2003. But we are unable to accept this argument of the learned Advocate for the respondent bank. The decree in question was passed long before in the year 1991 and thereafter 3 execution cases were filed one after another and all of those execution cases were dismissed for default for the laches/negligence of the decree-holder bank. This fact cannot be ignored or brushed asider, Since at the time of coming of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 into force this decree in question was alive (as the 12 years time from the date of decree as mentioned in section 48 of the Code of Civil Procedure was yet to expire) this decree was executable under this new Ain of 2003 but on fulfillment of all the conditions laid down in section 28 of this new Ain as quoted above. 

 The learned advocate for the respondent-bank has argued also that the executing court concerned, consideration the facts and circumstances, condoned the delay in filing this execution case by the impugned order No.4 dated 02.10.2003 and as such the question of limitation cannot be reopened now in this writ petition. But we do not accept this contention also of the learned advocate for the respondent bank. The Artha Rin Adalat Ain is a special law. Section 28 of this Ain has specified the period of limitation for filing the execution cases under this Ain. Sub-section 2, 3 and 4 of Section 28 have provided also that the execution cases filed beyond the time limited prescribed by this Section 28 will be barred by limitation and will be rejected by the Adalat summarily. So, there was no scope for condoning the delay in filing this execution case and as such the impugned order No.4 dated 02.10.2003 condoning the delay in filing this execution case was illegal. So, from the above discussion it is evident that the execution case in question being filed beyond the time limit prescribed by Sub section (3) (4) of Section 28 of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 is barred by limitation and as such the auction sale of the mortgaged property of these petitioners in that execution case also is illegal." 

 4. The learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner bank submitted in the light of the observations made by the High Court Division quoted herein above. It appears that the instant Execution Case arises out the judgment and decree passed on 23.04.1991 and that the I' execution case was registered as Execution Case No.37 of 1993. and thereafter two others Execution Cases being Execution Case Nos.12 of 1997 and 73 of 2000 were filed and in course of time those was dismissed and thereafter on 25.08.2003 the last Execution Case being Artha Rin Decree Case No.220 of 2003 was filed which has been renumbered as Artha Decree Case No.58 of 2004 filed in the Court of Artha Rin Malat, Comilla. Section 48 of the Code of Civil Procedure provides that where an application for execution of a decree is required to be filed, fresh application presented after expiration of 12 years is not maintainable. In the instant case it appears that the last Execution Case was filed beyond 12 years from the date of the decree in that the decree was passed on 23.04.1991 and the last Artha Decree 'Case No.220 of 2003 was filed on 25.08.2003, which thus show that the case has been filed after more than 12 years and 4 months from the date of the decree. Thus it is hopelessly time barred. It also appears that the last Execution Case has been filed after the promulgation of Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 and as per Section 60 of the said Act any pending proceeding is to be proceeded with under the Provision of new Act and Section 28 of the said Act provides the limitation for execution case under the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 and the maximum period of limitation of 6 years provided such execution case filed within one year from the disposal of the previous execution case filed under the said Act. In the instant case the provision of Section 28 cannot be applied inasmuch as the limitation of 6 years expired prior to promulgation of new Act, 2003. Be that as it may since the execution case has been filled after more than 12 years Section-48 of Code Civil Procedure is of no help. The leave petition do not merit consideration being barred by limitation.
